testcase.name: tenants are not distinguished - the horizon is age only, and other tenants' recent rows survive()
a backlog is worked off in bounded batches, oldest first, over several runs()
an abandoned RUNNING run becomes eligible only after the sweeper failed it and it aged again()
schedule ledger - a CLAIMED fire is never deleted, a final one is()
approvals - a pending one never ages out, a final one does()
action runs - finished rows age out, a RUNNING row never does()
a horizon shorter than the replay window is refused()
workflow runs - payloads are blanked first and rows deleted later, active runs are never touched()
a final approval whose workflow run is still active is kept()
a cancelled and a failed run age out like a succeeded one()
a failing target does not stop the others and cannot spin()
